mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 4.

Russian attacks have left more than 850,000 Ukrainians without power, and President Volodymyr Zelensky reported a Russian drone strike in the town of Komyshuvakha.

France announced that European nations will take part in the Russia-Ukraine peace talks scheduled to begin on Monday in Abu Dhabi under U.N. mediation.

Albanian transport minister Fatmir Zekolli said the Skopje-Belgrade highway is slated to open in the summer of 2030, noting that the second segment will cross 304 privately owned parcels.

German Balkan analyst Kurt W. Bassuener called for a European investigation into the Banjskë incident, urging scrutiny of possible involvement by Serbian state structures.

Serbian opposition MP Marinika Tepiq released the full Sky ECC encrypted-app communications, linking former official Filip Koraqin to organized-crime networks and the BIA.
